farm_cam.mechanism: Rotating crank l1, constant-length link l2 with prescribed horizontal endpoint, and vertical link l3; longitudinal compensation converted to a rotating cam with roller normal offset.

formulas.longitudinal_motion: x_T = [zero dwell, T/2*(cos(xi)+1), T dwell]; x_v=j*T/num; compensation=x_T-x_v
formulas.linkage: ||p2-p1||=l2 and p2.x=compensation by alternating projection; p3=p2-[0,l3]
formulas.closure_export: Append first point; default writes actual/offset 1001-by-3 XYZ text with Z=0 using w+.

source_limitations: fixed normal direction without automatic point-order/orientation switch
fixed sample-index phase, no car-wheel travel
